cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Combines offline veterinary/agronomic knowledge retrieval (RAG) with region-aware reasoning, giving livestock disease triage and Natural-Region-specific crop advisory for Zimbabwean smallholder farmers with zero connectivity.

test_prompts.prompt: My cow has a high fever and keeps pushing its head against the kraal post, walking in circles. What's wrong and what do I do right now?
There are ragged holes and droppings in the middle of my young maize plants, what's eating them?
